title: fix: simplify agent model listings
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows one compact, truncated agent description line while retaining the full tooltip.
- Moves the base model into a small tooltip chip beside base-model pricing.
- Moves Pollinations tool billing details beneath pricing and replaces repeated rate copy with one Agents legend.
- Keeps non-agent community model rows unchanged.

Checks:
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run build:frontend`

gist.headline: Agents, less table sprawl
gist.blurb: The agent shelf got a small pruning. Descriptions now keep their full story in a tooltip, while pricing and tool billing have stopped repeating themselves.
gist.summary: Simplified agent model rows with one truncated description line and full tooltip, a base-model tooltip chip beside pricing, tool billing beneath pricing, and a single Agents rate legend.
gist.impact: Users browsing agent models get the same base-model, pricing, and tool-billing details in a more compact table, while community model rows remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tidies a cozy garden-style model catalog: long agent-description vines are neatly trimmed into one small label, while a tiny tooltip sign preserves the full vine and a compact price-tag chip sits beside a glowing retro terminal. A small legend plaque replaces repeated signs; use flowers and code-plants to make the information cleanup feel warm rather than sterile.
